summary.business_type: Real Estate Advisory (Hybrid/Service-Area Business) - Bengaluru, India
top_findings: Self-contradictory RERA number on assetz-palmscape blog post (sidebar vs. body text)
3 project pages (sattva-la-vita, sattva-lumina, sattva-aeropolis) have zero real listing schema, only defunct FAQPage
Invalid non-numeric Product price format on orchid-salisbury breaks Rich Results eligibility
No verifiable Google Business Profile signals anywhere on-site
Catastrophic LCP (13-15s) on blog and area templates from unoptimized images
GSC/GA4 access blocked by missing service-account permissions and a disabled API
quick_wins: Add FAQPage schema to the 4 area hub pages (visible FAQ content already exists)
Fix mobile sidebar-widget overflow bug on 11 remaining project pages (1-line CSS, proven fix on 5 pages)
Trim meta descriptions sitewide (161-262 chars vs ~155-160 budget)
Fix the Assetz Palmscape RERA sidebar contradiction once correct value confirmed
Grant GSC/GA4 service account access (3 console actions, ~10 minutes)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Valid, complete sitemap; correct canonicals everywhere
No accidental noindex; unique titles/descriptions across all 62 pages
Rich varied JSON-LD across content types
Clean single-hop redirects, no chains
Fully static/pre-rendered HTML, no JS-rendering risk
HSTS present via Netlify

findings.title: .htaccess is dead code on Netlify
findings.description: Redirect/block rules don't actually execute on Netlify hosting; currently harmless by luck but fragile for future changes.
findings.recommendation: Delete the inert .htaccess; use a real _redirects file or netlify.toml if explicit control is needed.

findings.title: Missing baseline security headers beyond HSTS
findings.description: No X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on any tested page.
findings.recommendation: Add a Netlify _headers file applying baseline security headers to /*.

findings.title: Meta descriptions systematically too long
findings.description: 161-262 characters across nearly every area/project/blog page, versus Google's ~155-160 char display budget.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~120-155 characters, front-loading the strongest differentiator.

findings.title: Unbacked AggregateRating schema on 2 project pages
findings.description: assetz-palmscape and orchid-salisbury declare ratings with no matching visible on-page reviews.
findings.recommendation: Remove or add a genuine visible review summary matching the JSON-LD values.

findings.title: No IndexNow integration
findings.description: No IndexNow key file; site publishes new pages frequently.
findings.recommendation: Add an IndexNow key and a post-deploy ping hook.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Consistent NAP/RERA disclaimers in every footer sampled
Solid Person schema with hasCredential for the named advisor
Area guides and project pages comfortably clear word-count floors
Best comparison post is genuinely differentiated, not filler

findings.title: Self-contradictory RERA claim on a live page
findings.description: assetz-palmscape-devanahalli-price-layout-rera states body text is pre-launch/TBD RERA, but sidebar shows a specific number matching a different project's prefix.
findings.recommendation: Confirm correct status with the business, do not guess; add a build-time check comparing sidebar RERA to canonical project RERA.

findings.title: Blog posts thin and bulk-published
findings.description: All ~30 posts run 650-1,220 words vs a 1,500-word floor, published in a 17-day burst with dateModified frozen at datePublished.
findings.recommendation: Expand unique analysis per post or reclassify as a lighter content type; update dateModified as facts change.

findings.title: Byline/schema authorship mismatch
findings.description: Visible byline says 'Luxura Habitat Team' while JSON-LD names a single author, Narayanan Rajesh.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on one authorship model across visible copy and schema.

findings.title: No FAQ schema on blog posts
findings.description: 0 of 30 blog posts have FAQ/QA schema despite question-shaped content, vs 15/18 project pages that do.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 FAQ Q&A pairs per blog post template.

findings.title: Dense readability for a consumer audience
findings.description: Flesch Reading Ease ~38-40 (difficult/college level) for content aimed at first-time buyers and NRIs.
findings.recommendation: Add plain-language glosses for acronyms (RERA, BDA, IGBC, DC conversion, EOI).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles/meta descriptions across all pages
Solid H2/H3 heading structure
Coherent internal-linking topical cluster (area hub to comparison post to price/RERA post to project page)

findings.title: Meta descriptions too long sitewide
findings.description: Same as Technical SEO finding.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~120-155 characters.

findings.title: RERA/NAP footer inconsistent across templates
findings.description: Yelahanka drops the Tamil Nadu registration; 3 area pages have no NAP footer block at all.
findings.recommendation: Confirm correct RERA lines with the business, propagate identically everywhere.

findings.title: Very few question-format headings in blog content
findings.description: Only 5.4% of blog H2/H3 headings are phrased as questions.
findings.recommendation: Reframe headings as questions where natural.

findings.title: Two marketed micro-markets lack dedicated area pages
findings.description: Sarjapur Road and Whitefield appear in hero/schema but have no /areas/ page.
findings.recommendation: Build dedicated pages or scale back the marketing claim.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Blog template (30/30 posts) is a consistent, correct BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList implementation
tvs-emerald-altura is the best-built project page and should be the reference template
Homepage LocalBusiness is structurally valid
No deprecated schema types found anywhere

findings.title: 3 project pages have zero listing/business schema
findings.description: sattva-la-vita, sattva-lumina, sattva-aeropolis carry only FAQPage schema, which produces no Google rich result.
findings.recommendation: Add RealEstateListing/Offer schema matching the tvs-emerald-altura pattern.

findings.title: Invalid non-numeric price in Product schema
findings.description: orchid-salisbury uses price values like '1.03 Crore' (string) instead of a plain number.
findings.recommendation: Convert to numeric price with separate priceCurrency.

findings.title: Placeholder empty strings and relative URLs in project schema
findings.description: 4 project pages have empty url/logo fields or relative (non-absolute) image paths.
findings.recommendation: Fill with real values or omit; use absolute URLs everywhere.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList missing on 12 of 18 project pages and all hub pages
findings.description: Only 6 of 18 project pages have BreadcrumbList; /projects/, /blog/, /contact/, /testimonials/ have zero JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList consistently; add CollectionPage to hub pages.

findings.title: Area pages lack LocalBusiness/Place schema
findings.description: Area pages only carry generic WebPage + BreadcrumbList + Organization schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Place entity with GeoCoordinates per area page.

findings.title: About page Person schema URL mismatch
findings.description: Person @id/url uses the old flat about.html URL instead of the canonical /about/.
findings.recommendation: Update @id and url to match canonical.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Excellent TTFB (2-33ms) everywhere via Netlify edge CDN
CLS Good on homepage, area page, and blog post
Best Practices and SEO Lighthouse categories score 100 on every page
Site's own JS execution is light; third-party scripts are the real bottleneck

findings.title: LCP catastrophically poor on blog and area templates
findings.description: 13.87s and 15.33s LCP respectively, driven by unoptimized hero/content images with 83-99.8% waste.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF, resize to actual render dimensions, preload the LCP element.

findings.title: GTM and Zendesk widget consume significant main-thread time
findings.description: Up to 572ms + 210ms main-thread time on project pages.
findings.recommendation: Defer Zendesk until interaction; move GTM off the critical path.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet
findings.description: ~750ms wasted identically on every page.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts with font-display: swap and preload critical weights.

findings.title: Oversized logo images bloat every page
findings.description: Builder/partner logos and header logo run 70-155KB rendering at ~100x48px.
findings.recommendation: Re-export at proper size, target <10KB each.

findings.title: CLS Needs Improvement on project templates
findings.description: Unsized gallery/plan images cause layout shift.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height or aspect-ratio to gallery images.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present on all 241 images sampled in the blog section

findings.title: Hero/content images severely oversized
findings.description: 1.0-1.26MB images with 83-99.8% waste, no WebP/AVIF format.
findings.recommendation: Compress and convert to modern formats, resize to display dimensions.

findings.title: Logo images oversized relative to display size
findings.description: Builder/partner logos and header logo far larger than needed.
findings.recommendation: Re-export at proper resolution.

findings.title: Unsized images causing layout shift
findings.description: Project template gallery/plan images lack explicit dimensions.
findings.recommendation: Add width/height attributes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt maximally permissive for all AI crawlers
Fully static/SSR HTML across all 62 pages
Rich schema.org coverage, 140 Q&A pairs via project-page FAQPage schema
Named credentialed author entity with verifiable RERA registrations
23 pages use real data tables, good for citation extraction

findings.title: Area pages have visible FAQ content but zero FAQPage schema
findings.description: 3 of 4 area pages have hand-written FAQ content unmarked as structured data.
findings.recommendation: Apply the FAQPage pattern already proven on project pages.

findings.title: Blog posts have no Q&A blocks or question-format headings
findings.description: 0% Q&A blocks, only 5.4% question-phrased H2/H3s across 30 posts.
findings.recommendation: Reframe headings as questions, add FAQ blocks with schema.

findings.title: Yelahanka has no FAQ section at all
findings.description: Only area page without any Q&A content.
findings.recommendation: Author FAQs matching the other 3 area pages' format.

findings.title: Answer passages shorter than optimal citation length
findings.description: 16-90 words per paragraph vs the 134-167 word range that performs best for AI citation.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate short paragraphs into self-contained answer blocks.

findings.title: Authorship signal internally contradictory
findings.description: Same issue as Content Quality finding #3.
findings.recommendation: Standardize authorship across byline, footer, and schema.
